audit.root_cause: Two problems: the source dataset PrimeIntellect/longpdfs is private (the README says so), so no public user can load it, and the package imports `datasets` without declaring it, which breaks under verifiers 0.4.0 because that release no longer pulls in datasets.
audit.evidence: longpdfs/longpdfs.py:27 `DATASET = "PrimeIntellect/longpdfs"  # private HF dataset`; README.md:7 `(private HF dataset)`; pyproject deps only `verifiers>=0.3.1`; first_failure: `ModuleNotFoundError: No module named 'datasets'` (auto-installed); final: `DatasetNotFoundError: Dataset 'PrimeIntellect/longpdfs' doesn't exist on the Hub or cannot be accessed.` The verifiers 0.4.0 dependency list on PyPI has no datasets.
audit.irl_fix: Make the dataset public (or mark the env private) and add `datasets` to dependencies.
